questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Minute intestinal flukes (MIF)?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Small operculated eggs in stool; species identity may require molecular or adult-worm evidence.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Small operculated eggs in stool; species identity may require molecular or adult-worm evidence. Concentrated stool wet mounts at about 400×; record size using calibrated optics.
